scope: ROADMAP.md native A/B and nbc artifact retention
correction: The end-of-support cutoff was believed to impose an unconditional requirement to preserve all NBC/native-A/B history and recovery artifacts after 2026-09-30. Support retirement and artifact retention are separate: Accepted core ADR-0050 currently gates outside-stable retention on completion conditions, while Proposed core ADR-0052 would remove that NBC-specific obligation if accepted; core ADR-0048 still protects signed stable and its referenced bytes.
evidence: frostyard/core ADR-0047, ADR-0048, ADR-0050 (Accepted) and ADR-0052 (Proposed); ROADMAP.md prior preserve-history-and-recovery requirement
